assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: an isolated fabric swatch for a desktop interface, NOT a UI mockup. A real piece of softly washed, muted mid blue-gray DENIM with authentic diagonal cotton twill, photographed straight from above. A roughly rectangular portrait cloth piece, approximately 3:4 proportions, entirely visible against a genuinely transparent background. All four raw edges are naturally uneven and frayed, with irregular short loose cotton threads, a few shallow asymmetric torn notches, and gently damaged irregular corners. Keep the center 80 percent flat, calm, opaque, uniform and free of decorations so text can sit over it. The outline must feel hand-torn, not a perfect rectangle, not a repeated zigzag or scallop, not pinking-shear cuts. Leave about 4 percent transparent padding around the fraying. Soft diffuse even light, natural yarn detail, low contrast, no large folds, no curling corners or perspective, no cast shadow on a background. No hands, objects, patterns, hems, stitching, buttons, text, logos or watermarks. Real photographic material, no drawing, no vector, no CGI. Restrained desaturated blue denim color, fine realistic fibers, authentic damaged edges.
